# AiBOX.im

> AiBOX — Installed until it works. A portable desktop installer and maintenance companion for Windows and macOS that takes popular AI apps from download to a working, verified setup — no terminal, no admin prompts.

AiBOX.im is the official website for the AiBOX desktop app (open source, English default with Chinese available). It publishes the app catalog, step-by-step setup guides, downloads with SHA256 checksums, and a read-only data API that mirrors the GitHub registry.

## Key pages

- [Home (English)](https://aibox.im/en/): product overview and 3-step quick start
- [Home (中文)](https://aibox.im/zh/): 中文首页
- [Download](https://aibox.im/en/download/): portable Windows build, SHA256, SmartScreen guide
- [App catalog](https://aibox.im/en/apps/): every app AiBOX can install, with difficulty and platform badges
- [AI coding tools topic](https://aibox.im/en/collections/coding/): seven AI coding tools compared side by side — pick the one that matches where you work
- [Run models locally topic](https://aibox.im/en/collections/local-models/): run open AI models on your own computer — an engine (Ollama, GPT4All, Llamafile) plus clients that talk to it
- [OpenClaw setup guide](https://aibox.im/en/apps/openclaw/): install tutorial + model API-key configuration (six provider paths)
- [FAQ](https://aibox.im/en/faq/) · [Network self-check](https://aibox.im/en/guides/network-selfcheck/) · [SmartScreen guide](https://aibox.im/en/guides/smartscreen/)
- [Privacy](https://aibox.im/en/privacy/) · [About](https://aibox.im/en/about/)

## App catalog (21 apps)

- Example pages: [OpenClaw](https://aibox.im/en/apps/openclaw/), [Ollama](https://aibox.im/en/apps/ollama/), [Cherry Studio](https://aibox.im/en/apps/cherry-studio/), [Chatbox](https://aibox.im/en/apps/chatbox/), [Jan](https://aibox.im/en/apps/jan/), [Cline](https://aibox.im/en/apps/cline/), [ComfyUI](https://aibox.im/en/apps/comfyui/), [SillyTavern](https://aibox.im/en/apps/sillytavern/), [Pi](https://aibox.im/en/apps/pi/), [OpenCode](https://aibox.im/en/apps/opencode/), [Goose](https://aibox.im/en/apps/goose/)
- 29 apps in total — full list with difficulty, platforms and status: [GET /meta/index.json](https://aibox.im/meta/index.json). Every app also has an install-guide page at `https://aibox.im/en/apps/{id}/` (and `/zh/`).

## Data & API (for AI agents)

- Catalog snapshot: [GET /meta/index.json](https://aibox.im/meta/index.json) · per-app: `/meta/apps/{id}/app.json` · locales: `/meta/locales/{lang}.json` (mirrors the GitHub registry, rebuilt on every registry push)
- Machine-readable site summary: [llms.txt](https://aibox.im/llms.txt) · [agents.md](https://aibox.im/agents.md) · [OpenAPI](https://aibox.im/openapi.json)
- MCP endpoint (read-only): `POST https://aibox.im/mcp` — tool `get_aibox_info`
- Source of truth: [github.com/imAiBOX/aibox-registry](https://github.com/imAiBOX/aibox-registry) (also via jsDelivr and raw.githubusercontent.com)

## Downloads

- Latest desktop release: https://github.com/imAiBOX/aibox-app/releases/latest (`AiBOX-vX.Y.Z-windows-x64.exe`, portable, no installer)
- Source code: [aibox-app](https://github.com/imAiBOX/aibox-app) · [aibox-site](https://github.com/imAiBOX/aibox-site) · [aibox-registry](https://github.com/imAiBOX/aibox-registry)

## Notes

- Default language is English; Chinese is available at /zh/ (site) and via the in-app language switch.
- AiBOX is an independent community project and is not affiliated with the official apps listed in the catalog.
- Contact: open an issue at https://github.com/imAiBOX/aibox-app/issues

### OpenClaw (openclaw)

Multi-channel AI gateway that connects LLMs to your messengers (Telegram/WhatsApp, etc.), with six provider paths: Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / OpenRouter / Claude subscription / Ollama.

- Category: other
- Platforms: see app profile
- Install guide: https://aibox.im/en/apps/openclaw/

- Platforms: see app profile

# Agent instructions — aibox.im

Thank you for reading this. This file tells AI agents how to work with the AiBOX website and data.

## What AiBOX is

AiBOX (https://aibox.im) is a portable desktop installer for Windows and macOS that takes popular AI
applications from download to a working, verified setup — "Installed until it works." It scans the
machine, plans an install, downloads with multi-source fallback and SHA256 verification, writes model
API-key configuration, and verifies with a real test message. No terminal, no admin prompts.

## Canonical facts

- Product: AiBOX desktop app, portable single-file exe (Windows), macOS planned
- License: open source; repositories at https://github.com/imAiBOX (aibox-app, aibox-site, aibox-registry)
- Latest release: https://github.com/imAiBOX/aibox-app/releases/latest (asset `AiBOX-vX.Y.Z-windows-x64.exe`)
- Checksums: published on the download page and derived from GitHub Release asset digests
- Languages: English default; Chinese at /zh/ and in-app
- Catalog size: 29 apps (example ids: openclaw, ollama, cherry-studio, chatbox, jan, cline, comfyui, sillytavern, pi, opencode, goose, 5ire, dyad, zed) — full list in `GET /meta/index.json`
- Topic pages: https://aibox.im/en/collections/coding/ — AI coding tools compared (Cline, Continue, Aider, Zed, Codex, OpenCode, Pi) · https://aibox.im/en/collections/local-models/ — run models locally (Ollama, GPT4All, Llamafile + Chatbox, Cherry Studio, LobeHub)

## Machine-readable endpoints (no auth, read-only)

- `GET /meta/index.json` — app catalog snapshot (mirrors the GitHub registry; rebuilt on registry push)
- `GET /meta/apps/{id}/app.json` — full app profile (channels, sha256, install/probe, maintenance). Example: `/meta/apps/openclaw/app.json`
- `GET /meta/locales/{lang}.json` — UI locale packs
- `GET /llms.txt` — site summary in llms.txt format
- `GET /openapi.json` — OpenAPI description of the endpoints above
- `POST /mcp` — MCP endpoint; tool `get_aibox_info(section)` returns product/download/apps info
- Source of truth (SSOT): https://github.com/imAiBOX/aibox-registry — cross-check /meta against it

## Agent policy

- **Access**: all public pages and machine-readable endpoints are open to transparent AI crawlers. The site's `robots.txt` explicitly allows search/citation, hybrid and training crawlers. No login, API key, or user-agent cloaking is required.
- **Preferred data path**: use `/meta/index.json` and `/meta/apps/{id}/app.json` rather than scraping HTML. These are static snapshots of the public registry and include source URLs, checksums, platform support, prerequisites, and maintenance notes.
- **Attribution and accuracy**: identify the app as AiBOX (independent installer), not as any listed app's official publisher. Names and marks belong to their owners. When quoting app support/version data, cite the relevant registry profile and its `updatedAt` field.
- **Language**: English is the default; Chinese pages are available under `/zh/`. Preserve product names and technical identifiers verbatim.
- **MCP**: a read-only MCP endpoint is available at `https://aibox.im/.well-known/mcp` (alias of `/mcp`); tool `get_aibox_info` returns product, download, and catalog pointers.
- **Full site context**: see [llms.txt](https://aibox.im/llms.txt) and [llms-full.txt](https://aibox.im/llms-full.txt).
- **Safety**: do not ask users to paste API keys into public content; AiBOX writes keys locally. Do not claim affiliation with apps in the catalog.

## Contact

- Issues: https://github.com/imAiBOX/aibox-app/issues
